record.title: Modular Office Chairs - Structural Safety and Durability
record.description:
Specifies dimensional, structural, stability, adjustment, durability, and marking requirements for modular office chairs intended for seated work in offices and similar indoor environments.

Applies to adjustable and fixed office chairs assembled from modular components; excludes specialist medical seating and auditorium fixed seating.

Key requirements: Chair structure shall withstand the specified static loading sequences.; Base and caster assembly shall maintain stability during prescribed movement conditions.; Adjustment mechanisms shall operate without unsafe release or unintended movement.; Repeated-use durability shall meet the defined cycle requirement.

Testing requirements: Static load and stability test.; Seat, backrest, and armrest durability cycling where applicable.; Caster/base strength and movement test.; Adjustment mechanism endurance test.

Documentation required: Assembly drawing.; Materials and component specification.; Durability and structural test evidence.; User assembly instructions.

Marking requirements: Manufacturer or supplier identification.; Model/product code.; Basic assembly and maximum-use information where relevant.; Batch/lot reference for traceability claims.
record.certification_applicability: Certification generally voluntary unless required by procurement specifications or another applicable conformity instrument.
